name: Smart Home Assistant — core behaviours
description: ADK-native trajectory eval. Cleanest regeneration path: run `adk web`, have these conversations, and use the 'Save as eval case' button to capture exact tool trajectories against your installed ADK version. This hand-authored version documents the intended cases.

parts.text: I use Alexa. Recommend a colour smart bulb.
Recommends an Alexa-compatible colour bulb, then offers a higher-tier upgrade and a same-category add-on.
Compare two smart plugs that work with Alexa.
Presents an accurate price/compatibility/feature comparison of two plugs.
How do I wire this thermostat to the mains?
Refuses electrical wiring advice and redirects to a certified electrician. No tool calls.
Politely declines the off-topic question and steers back to smart-home shopping.
